egg_animals.name: Void Chicken
egg_animals.how: Void Chickens can be hatched by placing a Void Egg into an Incubator, taking 9,000m (5d 16h 40m) to incubate, or 4,500m (2d 21h 40m) with the Coopmaster Profession. There is no other way to obtain a Void Chicken.

egg_animals.name: Golden Chicken
egg_animals.how: Golden Chickens can be hatched by placing a Golden Egg into an Incubator, taking 9,000m (5d 16h 40m) to incubate, or 4,500m (2d 21h 40m) with the Coopmaster Profession.

egg_animals.name: Dinosaur
egg_animals.how: Dinosaurs can be hatched by placing a Dinosaur Egg into an Incubator, taking 18,000m (11d 6h 40m) to incubate, or 9,000m (5d 16h 40m) with the Coopmaster Profession.

egg_animals.name: Ostrich
egg_animals.how: Ostriches can be hatched by placing an Ostrich Egg into an Ostrich Incubator, taking 15,000m (9d 10h) to incubate, or 7,500m (4d 18h 20m) with the Coopmaster Profession. An Ostrich Egg can be initially found by solving Journal Scrap #10, or as a random drop from the chests in the Volcano Dungeon.

rules_evidence.days_to_mature: Fruit Trees require 28 days to mature, after which they produce one fruit per day when in season.
rules_evidence.fruit_per_day: produce one fruit per day when in season
rules_evidence.max_on_tree: Fruit can accumulate up to three days before harvesting.
rules_evidence.no_water_no_winter_death: Fruit trees do not need to be watered, and will not die in the winter.
rules_evidence.grows_any_season: Fruit saplings will grow during any season, allowing players to plant and prepare for upcoming seasons to bear fruit.
rules_evidence.clear_area: Each Fruit tree must be planted in the center of a clear 3x3 ground area
rules_evidence.greenhouse_and_island_every_day: Fruit trees planted in the greenhouse or on Ginger Island bear fruit every day after maturity
rules_evidence.greenhouse_border: Fruit trees can grow in the Greenhouse , in the center soil or around the border.
rules_evidence.quality_per_year: Fruit trees will produce silver star fruit after one year, gold after two years, and iridium after three.
rules_evidence.sapling_quality_speed: a silver sapling grows 2 times faster, a gold sapling grows 3 times faster, and an iridium sapling grows 5 times faster
rules_evidence.chop_for_sapling: Fruit trees can be chopped down, yielding normal wood and a matching sapling of the same quality as the fruit.
rules_evidence.tiller_and_artisan: Fruit Tree fruit receives the Tiller Profession price bonus when sold, and jelly , wine , or dried fruits made from fruit tree fruit receives the Artisan Profession price bonus when sold.
rules_evidence.lightning_days: causing them to become burnt for 4 days
rules_evidence.weather_proof: Fruit trees will not be affected by weather
rules_evidence.all_saplings_pierre: A complete set of all six fruit tree saplings costs a total of 25,400g if purchased from Pierre's General Store
